# What should this screen printing job cost?

> Free screen printing quote calculator: price per piece from blanks, screens, ink and press time, a price-break ladder, and the smallest order that pays at your current price. Runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
